channel.description: Aggregated headlines linking to original publishers

item.title: Man City continue to weather storm as Haaland scores twice in Ipswich win
item.description: Premier League leaders Manchester City earned a seventh straight win by beating Ipswich Town 3-2 as their on-pitch resistance showed no signs of slowing.

item.title: Wrexham thump four past dismal Preston
item.description: Wrexham eased the pressure on Phil Parkinson with a 4-1 Sky Bet Championship win over rock-bottom Preston.

item.title: Sorry Derby beaten at home by Stoke
item.description: Luke Graham scored his first goal for Stoke as they won 1-0 at Pride Park to pile more pressure on struggling Derby.

item.title: Sheff Utd battle to narrow win at Bristol City
item.description: Oliver Arblaster's early strike and a strong defensive display saw Sheffield United take all three points from a 1-0 Championship victory over Bristol City at Ashton Gate.

item.title: Millar double fires Birmingham past QPR
item.description: Liam Millar scored twice as Birmingham won a crucial Sky Bet Championship clash 3-0 with QPR at St Andrew's.

item.title: Struggling Norwich beaten by Portsmouth
item.description: Portsmouth piled on the misery for struggling Norwich as they made it back-to-back Championships victories with a 1-0 triumph at Carrow Road.

item.title: West Brom hit back to beat Blackburn in five-goal thriller
item.description: West Brom completed a stunning comeback after conceding two early goals as they beat Blackburn 3-2 in the Sky Bet Championship.

item.title: West Ham win at Championship leaders Swansea
item.description: West Ham ended Swansea's four-match winning streak with a 1-0 away success that reduced the gap at the top of the Sky Bet Championship to a single point.

item.title: Southampton frustrated at home by Bolton
item.description: James Bree, Lewis Dobbin and Leo Scienza all squandered chances as Southampton dropped points at home for the first time this season with a 0-0 draw against Bolton.
